headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings of relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs. In other action, the St. Louis Cardinals took down the Chicago Cubs 8-4 behind a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy, who pitched 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Boston Red Sox placed designated hitter Masataka Yoshida on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The Red Sox also placed right-handed pitcher Justin Slaten on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 13, 2026, with a right elbow inflammation. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Toronto Blue Jays, Los Angeles Angels, Milwaukee Brewers, Seattle Mariners, Chicago White Sox, and San Francisco Giants.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their infield with the trade acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas from the Athletics for cash. The Athletics also traded center fielder Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a player-to-be-named-later deal from the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
